title: Fragment 换页带自定义动画时，目标 NavDestination 写 customTransition

triggers.read: 源码进入详情或覆盖页面时用 FragmentTransaction.setCustomAnimations(…) 配 res/anim 资源，或先用动画辅助方法缩放列表项再 replace fragment
triggers.wrong: 目标只写 navPathStack.pushPathByName(...)，对应 NavDestination 上没有 .customTransition(...)，走 Navigation 默认滑入；缩放层也没有

scope: 安卓 Fragment 换页带自定义动画、迁成 ArkUI Navigation/NavDestination 时；customTransition 自 API 15 起有（出自声明）

how.text: 列出源端 setCustomAnimations 的 enter / exit / popEnter / popExit 四个资源各自的 alpha、scale 起止值、时长和插值器；源端先缩放列表项的，把这段缩放层按源实现一并迁过去

在进出的 NavDestination 上写 .customTransition((operation: NavigationOperation, isEnter: boolean) => [{ duration: <源时长>, curve: <对应曲线>, event: () => { <opacity/scale 改到终值> } }])：PUSH 时 isEnter 对 enter、否则对 exit；POP 时对 popEnter / popExit

values.meaning: NavDestination 的自定义转场；和 systemTransition 都设时后设的生效

values.value: type NavDestinationTransitionDelegate = (operation: NavigationOperation, isEnter: boolean) => Array<NavDestinationTransition> | undefined
values.meaning: 按操作和进出方向返回一组转场

values.value: NavDestinationTransition { event: Callback<void>; duration?: number（默认 1000 ms）; curve?: Curve（默认 Curve.EaseInOut）; delay?: number（默认 0）; onTransitionEnd?: Callback<void> }
values.meaning: 每段转场的参数；源时长要显式写
区分进入和返回，分别对应源端 enter/exit 和 popEnter/popExit

values.value: setCustomAnimations(enter, exit, popEnter, popExit)：popEnter/popExit 只在弹回栈时播放；两参数版本弹栈时不播放
values.meaning: 源端四个资源和目标 PUSH/POP × isEnter 的对应

lookups.what: 源端换页动画的起止值、时长和插值器
lookups.where: 源工程 res/anim 或 res/animator 下 setCustomAnimations 引用的 XML；缩放辅助方法里的 Animator 时长常量
lookups.how: <alpha>/<scale> 的 from/to 值作起止状态，android:duration 解析成毫秒，interpolator 对到 curve

why: 只写路由 push 时换页走系统默认滑入，源端的淡出覆盖和卡片缩放进入都不存在
unverified: 卡里环境是 API 24，本机按 API 23 声明核实
alternatives_unverified: 在宿主 Navigation 上用 customNavContentTransition(delegate: (from, to, operation) => NavigationAnimatedTransition | undefined) 统一写转场（卡里修复放在 NavDestination.customTransition）
siblings_checked: 搜 NavDestinationTransitionDelegate：只有 NavDestinationAttribute.customTransition 一个；宿主侧另有 NavigationAttribute.customNavContentTransition（参数类型不同，记在 alternatives_unverified）

refs.quote: If both this attribute and systemTransition are set, whichever is set later takes effect.
declare type NavDestinationTransitionDelegate = (operation: NavigationOperation, isEnter: boolean) => Array<NavDestinationTransition> | undefined;
Duration of the transition animation. * Default value: **1000** (in milliseconds).
Curve type of the animation. * Default value: Curve.EaseInOut.
Closure function specifying the transition animation.

refs.what: setCustomAnimations 的 popEnter/popExit 只在弹栈时播放
refs.quote: The popEnter * and popExit animations will be played for enter/exit * operations specifically when popping the back stack.
